headings: Largest LTL Pure-Player with Exceptional Network Scale and Proximity
Robust Commercial Value Proposition with Differentiated Dual-Service Offering
Proprietary and Digitally Enabled Technology Platform
paragraphs: Headquartered in Memphis, Tennessee, FedEx Freight is the largest North American less-than-truckload ("LTL") freight carrier, with industry-leading transit times and service levels, offering choice, simplicity, and reliability to meet the needs of LTL shippers while operating ethically with a commitment to "Safety Above All." As of June 1, 2026, we had approximately 40,000 employees, over 365 locations, including approximately 355 shipping terminals (over 320 of which are in the United States) and approximately 10 linehaul relay sites, and nearly 30,000 motorized vehicles, of which nearly 17,000 are tractors, across all 50 U.S. states, Canada, and Mexico. We also offer freight delivery service to most points in Puerto Rico and the U.S. Virgin Islands. Our robust network established through almost 60 years of operations and consisting of more than 26,000 service center doors strategically positioned in high-demand regions provides critical services that facilitate the transport of goods in North America and powers the supply chains of our customers. Our services and solutions support companies of all sizes, industries, and specialties, and our proximity to our customers allows us to transport their goods quickly, reliably, and efficiently.

Our LTL portfolio consists of two complementary service offerings designed to address distinct customer shipping requirements, serving both time-critical and cost-sensitive freight across a single integrated network:

•FedEx Freight Priority: A premium, time-definite LTL service designed for shipments requiring the fastest available transit. Priority offers industry-leading published transit times, including next-business-day service for shipments traveling up to 600 miles and second-business-day service for shipments traveling up to 1,600 miles. The service provides broad coverage across the United States, Canada, and Mexico and is backed by a money-back service guarantee if published delivery commitments are not met, providing customers with a high degree of reliability for time-critical freight.

•FedEx Freight Economy: A value-oriented LTL service designed for shipments with more flexible transit requirements. Economy provides broad coverage across the United States and Canada, including service to and from Puerto Rico and service to the U.S. Virgin Islands through strategic alliances. The service offers reliable and cost-effective transportation for customers seeking to optimize shipping costs while maintaining consistent service performance. Shipments moving under FedEx Freight Economy are generally not covered by a money-back service guarantee.

In addition, FedEx Custom Critical provides expedited, time-specific freight solutions, including Surface Expedite and White Glove Services, available 24/7/365, which are discussed further below under "Business Strategy and Operations."

Customers can also process domestic and cross-border LTL shipments to and from Canada and Mexico, as well as intra-Canada and intra-Mexico shipments, through our digital customer platforms, including LTL Select, a free cloud-based, multi-carrier transportation management system.
We have a number of ongoing initiatives intended to continue optimizing our operating model and financial performance, which are discussed further below under "Business Strategy and Operations."

Prior to June 1, 2026, FedEx Freight operated as a group of wholly owned subsidiaries of FedEx. On December 19, 2024, FedEx announced its plan to spin-off FedEx Freight into an independent, publicly traded company. On June 1, 2026, FedEx completed the Spin-Off through its distribution of 80.1% of the outstanding shares of our common stock on a pro-rata basis to the holders of FedEx common stock. Following the Spin-Off, our common stock began trading under the ticker symbol "FDXF" on the New York Stock Exchange ("NYSE").

See Item 7. "Management's Discussion and Analysis of Results of Operations and Financial Condition" for information regarding costs and other financial-related items related to the Spin-Off and Item 13. Effective for the period beginning June 1, 2026, the Company's fiscal year-end has changed from May 31 to December 31. Except as otherwise specified, any reference to a year in this Annual Report indicates our fiscal year ended May 31, 2026 or ended May 31 of the year referenced, and comparisons are to the corresponding period of the prior year.

Trucking companies provide two main types of services across industries and end-markets: truckload ("TL") and LTL services. We are the largest provider of LTL services to customers across North America. The LTL industry is a segment of the freight transportation market that specializes in the consolidation and transport of shipments that do not require the full capacity of a truck trailer. This model allows LTL providers to offer cost-effective solutions for businesses that need to ship goods between various locations but do not have sufficient freight to justify hiring a full TL carrier. LTL carriers utilize network-based production logic to link different shipments into multi-stop routes and benefit from a semi- or fully-scheduled linehaul. This results in LTL carriers typically requiring a more expansive and sophisticated network of local pickup and delivery as freight is picked up from multiple customers and routed through a network of

service centers and transferred to other trucks with similar destinations. This sophisticated network structure enables shippers to flexibly manage variable shipment volumes and dispatch freight on demand.

There are certain market dynamics that influence LTL services with respect to pricing, routing, and carrier options that are different from the TL operating models. Customer pricing for TL solutions is typically rigid with one price for the entire trailer, irrespective of the shipment size, while LTL offerings are typically more flexible, with origin, destination, class, and weight being the drivers of price. This makes LTL generally more cost-effective than TL for shipments smaller than a full trailer, due to its hub-and-spoke routing model with cross-docking across terminals. In contrast, TL typically operates point-to-point without consolidation terminals, using customized, on-demand routes that may be non- or semi-scheduled. Historically, there has been more favorable pricing and economics in the North American LTL market, which consists of approximately 10 scaled players, as compared to the more fragmented North American TL market.

Risks Relating to Macroeconomic and Geopolitical Conditions
We are directly affected by the state of the global economy and geopolitical developments, which has affected the demand for our services and could materially adversely affect our business.

Risks Relating to Operations and Strategies
Adverse publicity relating to our own activities or FedEx's activities could materially adversely affect our reputation and reduce the value of our goodwill and brand.

We are self-insured for certain costs associated with our operations, and insurance and claims expenses may increase, which could materially adversely affect our profitability and financial condition.
We may not be able to achieve our medium-term financial performance targets.

We have been and may be subject to new and revised regulations related to the transportation industry, which could increase our compliance costs and materially adversely affect our business.

FedEx Freight is a leading North American provider of LTL freight transportation services. We offer a range of services designed to meet the diverse needs of LTL shippers including time-critical transportation needs leveraging our advanced tracking capabilities and a comprehensive network of service centers and hubs that facilitate efficient delivery and pickup. FedEx Freight's service offerings include priority services when speed is critical and economy services when time can be traded for savings. FedEx Freight is our sole reportable segment.

FedEx Freight, Inc. was created through several acquisitions by FedEx Corporation ("FedEx"), including Viking Freight, Inc. in January 1998, American Freightways, Inc. in February 2001, and Watkins Motor Lines in May 2006. In April 2002, American Freightways, Inc. was renamed FedEx Freight East, Inc. and Viking Freight, Inc. was renamed FedEx Freight West, Inc. In May 2006, the Watkins Motor Lines business was renamed FedEx National LTL, Inc. In December 2008, FedEx Freight East, Inc. and FedEx Freight West, Inc. merged and became FedEx Freight, Inc., which was wholly owned by FedEx Freight Corporation. In January 2011, FedEx National LTL, Inc. merged into FedEx Freight, Inc. On June 1, 2024, FedEx Freight Corporation merged into FedEx Freight, Inc., and ownership of FedEx Custom Critical, Inc. ("FedEx Custom Critical") was transferred from another FedEx subsidiary to FedEx Freight, Inc. On September 1, 2024, FedEx Freight Canada Holding Company, Inc., formerly a subsidiary of FedEx Freight Corporation, merged into FedEx Freight, Inc. and its subsidiary, FedEx Freight Canada Corp. ("FedEx Freight Canada"), became a subsidiary of FedEx Freight, Inc.

On July 14, 2025, FedEx Freight Holding Company, Inc. was incorporated to serve as the ultimate parent company of FedEx Freight, Inc. in connection with the planned Spin-Off. Subsequently, on February 11, 2026, FDXF Holding Corporation was formed as an intermediate holding company to become a direct subsidiary of FedEx Freight Holding Company, Inc. On May 29, 2026, ownership of FedEx Freight, Inc. and its subsidiaries was transferred from another FedEx subsidiary to FDXF Holding Corporation. Immediately thereafter, ownership of FDXF Holding Corporation and its subsidiaries was transferred to FedEx Freight Holding Company, Inc.

The consolidated financial statements include the consolidated results of operations, financial position, and cash flows of FedEx Freight Holding Company, Inc. and its subsidiaries for all periods presented since the reorganizations were transactions under common control. See "Summary of Results" below and Item 1. "Business" elsewhere in this Annual Report for additional information.
The key indicators necessary to understand our operating results include:
•the overall customer demand for our various services based on macroeconomic factors and the North American and global economies;
•the volumes of transportation services provided through our network, primarily measured by our average daily shipments and shipment weight and size;
•the mix of services purchased by our customers;
•the prices we obtain for our services, primarily measured by yield (revenue per shipment or hundredweight);
•our ability to manage our cost structure (capital expenditures and operating expenses) to match shifting volume levels; and
•the timing and amount of fluctuations in fuel prices and our ability to recover incremental fuel costs through our fuel surcharges.

paragraphs: 本公司總部設於美國田納西州孟菲斯，FedEx Freight 是北美最大的零擔貨運電信業者（"LTL"），擁有業界領先的運輸時間與服務水準，提供選擇性、簡易性與可靠性，以符合 LTL 貨運發貨人需求，同時以 "安全為首要" 的承諾，秉持倫理價值進行營運。截至 2026 年 6 月 1 日，本公司約有 4 萬名員工，超過 365 個據點，包括約 355 個發貨站（其中超過 320 個位於美國），以及約 10 個運輸中轉站，並擁有近 3 萬輛動力車輛，其中近 1.7 萬輛為牽引車，遍及美國全 50 州、加拿大與墨西哥。本公司亦提供貨運配送服務至波多黎各與美國維吉尼亞羣島的大多數地區。我們透過近 60 年的營運所建立的強大網路，包含超過 2.6 萬個服務中心門戶， strategically positioned 在高需求地區，提供關鍵服務，促進北美貨物運輸，並支撐客戶的供應鏈。我們的服務與解決方案支持各規模、各產業與專業領域的公司，而我們與客戶的近距離關係，使我們能快速、可靠且高效地運輸客戶的貨物。
我們的 LTL 產品組合包含兩種互補的服務方案，設計用以應對不同的客戶貨運需求，透過單一整合網路，服務時間敏感與成本敏感的貨運：

•FedEx Freight Priority：一種高階、時間確定的 LTL 服務，設計用以處理需要最快運輸時間的貨運。Priority 提供業界領先的公佈運輸時間，包括對運輸距離達 600 英里的貨運提供次營業日服務，對運輸距離達 1,600 英里的貨運提供第二營業日服務。本服務提供廣泛的美國、加拿大與墨西哥覆蓋範圍，並在未達成公佈交付承諾時，提供退款服務保證，為客戶提供高度可靠的時間敏感貨運服務。

•FedEx Freight Economy：一種以價值導向的 LTL 服務，設計用以處理運輸時間需求較為靈活的貨運。Economy 提供廣泛的美國與加拿大覆蓋範圍，包括至波多黎各與美國維吉尼亞羣島的服務，透過策略性合作夥伴提供服務。本服務提供可靠且成本效益高的運輸服務，讓客戶在維持一致服務表現的同時，優化運輸成本。透過 FedEx Freight Economy 處理的貨運，通常不包含退款服務保證。
此外，FedEx Custom Critical 提供加急、時間特定的貨運解決方案，包括 Surface Expedite 與 White Glove Services，全年無休 24/7/365 可用，進一步說明請參閱下文 "商業策略與營運" 部分。
客戶亦可透過我們的數位客戶平台處理至加拿大與墨西哥的國內與跨境 LTL 貨運，以及加拿大與墨西哥境內的貨運，包括 LTL Select，這是一個免費的雲端多電信業者運輸管理系統。
我們有許多持續進行的計畫，旨在進一步優化營運模式與財務表現，進一步說明請參閱下文 "商業策略與營運" 部分。

在 2026 年 6 月 1 日之前，FedEx Freight 作為 FedEx 的全資子公司羣組運作。2024 年 12 月 19 日，FedEx 宣佈計畫將 FedEx Freight 分拆為獨立、公開上市的公司。2026 年 6 月 1 日，FedEx 透過發放本公司普通股 80.1% 的流通股數，按比例發放給 FedEx 普通股持有人，完成分拆。分拆後，本公司普通股開始在紐約證券交易所（"NYSE"）以 "FDXF" 為股票代碼進行交易。

貨運公司根據產業與最終市場，提供兩種主要類型的服務：零組件（"TL"）與 LTL 服務。本公司為北美地區客戶提供最大的 LTL 服務。LTL 行業為貨運運輸市場的一個分支，專門從事不需整輛卡車拖車容量之貨物的集貨與運輸。此模式使 LTL 提供商能為需要在不同地點間運送貨物但貨量不足以支撐整輛 TL 貨運的企業，提供更具成本效益的解決方案。LTL 貨運商利用基於網路的生產邏輯，將不同貨物連結至多點路線，並受益於半或全排程的運輸路線。這使得 LTL 貨運商通常需要更廣泛且複雜的本地取貨與配送網路，因貨物會從多個客戶處取貨，並透過網路轉運至其他具有相似目的地的卡車。
此高度複雜的網路結構使貨運發送者能靈活管理變動的貨物數量，並按需發運貨物。

某些市場動態會影響 LTL 服務的價格、路線及貨運商選擇，與 TL 運營模式有所不同。TL 解決方案的客戶價格通常較為固定，整輛拖車收取單一價格，與貨物大小無關；而 LTL 提供的服務通常更具彈性，出發地、目的地、貨物等級及重量為價格的主導因素。這使得 LTL 對於小於整輛拖車的貨物而言，通常比 TL 更具成本效益，因其採用樞紐- spokes 路線模型，並透過終端間的交叉裝卸進行運輸。相較之下，TL 通常為點對點運輸，不經集貨終端，使用客製化、按需路線，可能為非排程或半排程。歷史上，北美 LTL 市場的價格與經濟效益較為優渥，該市場約有 10 家規模較大的參與者，與較為分散的北美 TL 市場相比。
FedEx Freight 的策略建立在本公司廣大的規模、多樣化且高階的服務能力，以及科技驅動的平台之上，以進一步區隔我們的服務，並推動獲利成長。我們的優勢與成長策略包括以下內容。

FedEx Freight 是北美地區 LTL 貨運運輸服務的主要提供者。我們提供一系列服務，以符合 LTL 貨運發貨人多樣化之需求，包括時間至關重要的運輸需求，利用我們先進的追蹤功能及完整的服務中心與樞紐網路，以促進高效之交貨與取貨。FedEx Freight 之服務項目包括當速度至關重要時之優先服務，以及當時間可交換為節省成本時之經濟型服務。FedEx Freight 是我們唯一之應報告分部。

FedEx Freight, Inc. 是透過 FedEx Corporation ("FedEx") 進行多項收購而成立，包括 1998 年 1 月收購 Viking Freight, Inc.、2001 年 2 月收購 American Freightways, Inc.，以及 2006 年 5 月收購 Watkins Motor Lines。2002 年 4 月，American Freightways, Inc. 更名為 FedEx Freight East, Inc.，而 Viking Freight, Inc. 更名為 FedEx Freight West, Inc.。2006 年 5 月，Watkins Motor Lines 之業務更名為 FedEx National LTL, Inc.。2008 年 12 月，FedEx Freight East, Inc. 與 FedEx Freight West, Inc. 合併成為 FedEx Freight, Inc.，該公司為 FedEx Freight Corporation 之 wholly owned。2011 年 1 月，FedEx National LTL, Inc. 合併至 FedEx Freight, Inc.。2024 年 6 月 1 日，FedEx Freight Corporation 合併至 FedEx Freight, Inc.，並將 FedEx Custom Critical, Inc. ("FedEx Custom Critical") 之 ownership 從另一 FedEx 子公司轉移至 FedEx Freight, Inc.。2024 年 9 月 1 日，FedEx Freight Canada Holding Company, Inc.（原為 FedEx Freight Corporation 之子公司）合併至 FedEx Freight, Inc.，其子公司 FedEx Freight Canada Corp. ("FedEx Freight Canada") 亦成為 FedEx Freight, Inc. 之子公司。

2025 年 7 月 14 日，FedEx Freight Holding Company, Inc. 被設立，作為 FedEx Freight, Inc. 之最終母公司，以配合預計之分拆。隨後，2026 年 2 月 11 日，FDXF Holding Corporation 被設立為中間控股公司，成為 FedEx Freight Holding Company, Inc. 之直接子公司。2026 年 5 月 29 日，FedEx Freight, Inc. 及其子公司之 ownership 從另一 FedEx 子公司轉移至 FDXF Holding Corporation。隨即，FDXF Holding Corporation 及其子公司之 ownership 轉移至 FedEx Freight Holding Company, Inc.
合併財務報表包含 FedEx Freight Holding Company, Inc. 及其子公司自重組以來之合併營運成果、財務狀況及現金流，因重組為共同控制下之交易。請參閱下方之 "營運成果摘要" 以及本年度報告其他處之項目 1. "業務" 以取得更多資訊。
瞭解我們營運成果所必需之關鍵指標包括：
•本公司各項服務之總體客戶需求，取決於總體經濟因素及北美與全球經濟狀況;
•透過本公司網路所提供之運輸服務數量，主要以平均每日貨運量及貨運重量與尺寸衡量;
•客戶購買新服務之組合;
•本公司所獲得之服務價格，主要以每貨運或百磅之營業收入（yield）衡量;
•本公司管理成本結構（資本支出及營運費用）以配合變動之貨運量之能力; 和
•燃料價格之時點與變動幅度，以及本公司回收額外燃料成本之能力透過燃料附加費。

headings: 與我們業務及產業相關的風險
與我們普通股相關的風險
與總體經濟及地緣政治條件相關的風險
我們直接受到全球經濟狀況及地緣政治發展的影響，這些因素已影響我們服務的需求，並可能對我們的業務造成重大不利影響。
我們的業務及營運成果受燃料價格及供應量的影響，同時也取決於我們收取燃料附加費的能力。
與本公司或 FedEx 之活動相關之負面宣傳，可能重大不利影響本公司聲譽，並降低本公司 goodwill 及品牌價值。
本公司對部分營運相關成本為自負風險，保險及賠償費用可能增加，這可能重大不利影響本公司獲利能力與財務狀況。
本公司可能無法達成中短期財務績效目標。
第三方服務供應商未能如預期執行，或與該等第三方之關係中斷，或其提供之服務中斷，可能重大不利影響本公司業務。
與法規及法律事務相關風險
本公司已並可能面臨與運輸業相關之新法規與修正法規，這可能增加本公司遵循法規之成本，並重大不利影響本公司業務。
本公司業務受複雜之資料隱私權、資料安全、網路安全及人工智慧法規與法規所影響，這可能顯著增加本公司成本，並不利影響本公司業務
與員工事務及人力資源管理相關的風險
與勞工相關的動盪及潛在的勞動法規變動可能幹擾我們的營運，並對我們的業務及營運結果造成重大不利影響。
與科技、資料及智慧財產權相關的風險
重大資料外洩或其他對我們科技基礎建設的幹擾，可能對我們的業務造成重大不利影響，並導致關鍵、敏感或機密資訊的遺失。
與環境、氣候、天氣及其他災難相關的風險
我們已同意多項限制，以維持分割後非認列稅待遇及相關交易的非認列稅處理，這可能會降低我們的戰略及營運彈性。
分割後的非經常性及經常性成本，包括與FedEx提供過渡服務相關的成本，可能高於我們預期，且可能持續支出的時間長於我們預期。
我們可能無法實現部分或全部預期的分割效益，或這些效益可能被延後。
paragraphs: 除本年度報告其他部分所載之資訊，包括但不限於第 1 項「業務」、第 1C 項「網路安全」、第 3 項「法律訴訟」及第 7 項「管理層對營運結果及財務狀況之討論與分析」外，您應謹慎考量下列因素，這些因素可能對本公司之業務、營運結果、財務狀況及普通股價格造成重大不利影響。除目前已知或目前認為不重要之風險外，尚有其他風險可能對本公司之業務、營運結果、財務狀況及普通股價格造成重大不利影響。雖然下列風險已按標題分類，並分別討論，但許多風險彼此間具有關聯性。
本公司之業務面臨許多風險與不確定性，包括但不限於：
•總體經濟條件，包括通貨膨脹、利率、供應鏈中斷、地緣政治衝突及貿易政策變動（包括關稅）；
•客戶對商品之需求，以及生產、存貨與配送模式之變動；
•燃料價格與供應中斷，以及本公司在透過燃料附加費回收此等成本之能力受到限制；
•未能成功執行本公司之業務策略，並有效回應市場動態與客戶偏好之變動；
